description: Returns the plans, the price per user (amount, currency, period, taxes), what each plan includes, the free trial and its conditions, and the trial and demo links, as the pricing page publishes them. Use it for: how much per user, is yearly billing cheaper, is there a free trial, is a card needed, what is included. For any total (a team, several users, one user over a year), call devis: never multiply a price yourself. Returns no total.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.
